en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings. On the left is a large, ornate building facing a small park or square with trees and paths. On the right are commercial buildings with shopfronts and awnings. Pedestrians walk along the street, and the overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European town. Text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the place and photographer.
